title: Tommy S NDE 4187
content: 8-8-2002 I was going to do a simple task that I had done several times before. This was to build up a small place in a chipper throat that was worn down; this was causing wood slabs to hang and not feed into the chipper. So, after the mill shut down for the day, I assigned other workers to do other chores so we could all go home early because it was such a hot and very humid day in Louisiana. After performing all safety tasks, I proceeded into the small throat of the chipper to make the weld to build up the place where the problem was. After crawling in there, I realized I had put my ground in the wrong place and I needed my slag hammer. I started to crawl backwards to get out when a naked place in the stinger lead contacted the metal trough that I was lying in. I was soaking wet with sweat and the electricity went in my arm and stomach and would not let me go. I couldn't yell or anything to get away and I could not breathe, so basically I suffocated to death and my heart stopped. Suddenly I remembered I had done everything I could now it was in the Lord's hands, so I started praying for God to help me. I saw this tunnel of white light drawing closer and closer and I was not afraid or in pain anymore, all I felt was peace. Later I woke up briefly to vomit in the ambulance and there were angels attending me all in white. When I made mention of this later to the nurses they told me it was not us we all have on purple scrubs. And when arriving in the hospital I was still unconscious but I could see myself from above the table with my wife there holding my hand and IVs in me and covered with ice and doctors and nurses everywhere working on me.

arrival.other_being_detail: Angels described as 'attending me all in white' (seen in the ambulance).

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Electrocution while welding inside a wood chipper throat; reported suffocation and heart stopping.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Angels 'attending me all in white' in the ambulance; later OBE observing self on hospital table with wife and medical staff.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Tunnel/light first; later a brief waking/vomiting in ambulance with angels present; then an OBE at the hospital seeing self from above the table.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Angels perceived in the ambulance wearing white; nurses later said staff wore purple scrubs. OBE at hospital included seeing wife holding his hand, IVs, being covered with ice, and staff working on him.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I saw this tunnel of white light drawing closer and closer and I was not afraid or in pain anymore, all I felt was peace.”; “I could see myself from above the table with my wife there holding my hand and IVs in me and covered with ice and doctors and nurses everywhere working on me.”; “they told me it was not us we all have on purple scrubs.”
